CASINO - RULETA
Acierta rojo/negro y se doblan tus puntos apostados; si fallas (o sale 0 verde) los pierdes.
APUESTA:
PC: WASD drive · mouse = sight (always) · click (hold) fire · Shift toggle scope (first person) · V camera 1st/3rd person · T tree (at spawn between waves) · 6 fire extinguisher · 1/2/3 ammo AP / APFSDS / APDS · Esc menu
Touch: left stick drive · drag right side = aim · tap/FIRE = shoot · ZOOM · ☰ menu
Reload like War Thunder: the ring around the gun marker fills as the loader works; the first-stage rack reloads fast, once empty it reloads slower and refills while you hold fire. Full racks are more likely to explode when penetrated. Ammo is restocked when a wave is cleared.
Research with RP earned from kills. Aim at the thin side/rear armour — front plates ricochet shells. Crew, ammo racks and engine fires decide fights.
Shells are APHE like in War Thunder: after penetrating, the shell keeps travelling inside the tank, explodes after its fuse delay and sprays fragments that can kill crew, wreck the engine, light the fuel or set off the ammo. A shell with enough energy left can go straight through the tank and hit what is behind it. Hulls are NOT stabilised: when you turn the hull the turret turns with it. Press 6 to put out a fire. KV-2 and STURMTIGER also carry HE (key 4): the shell explodes on contact and the blast OVERPRESSURE (kPa) reaches the crew through the armour - it depends on explosive mass, distance and armour thickness (thin armour = blast penetration). When you die, a kill-cam replays the shell entering your tank, exploding and hurting the internal modules (any key skips it).
